data.name: Umbral Shroud
data.description: When the shadow caller reaches 7th level, her shade can emit a 10-foot aura of swirling shadows that grants all allies 20%% concealment against creatures without darkvision or the see in darkness ability, and a +4 bonus on Stealth checks.
